referenceSources.title: FIA Historic Database
referenceSources.description:
A black three-door Fiat Bravo HGT 2.0 20V hatchback is presented on a white backdrop, highlighting its sporty alloy wheels, integrated side skirts, and aerodynamic body-colored bumpers. The compact, performance-focused design is evident in its sloping roofline and aggressive front fascia.

This model was officially homologated under FIA Appendix K regulations on January 2, 1997, with homologation number 5558 for Group N competition. The form lists a 1197 cc engine and remained valid until January 1, 2007, with two transmission-related extensions recorded on March 2, 2002.
